XCAPITOLO.Corpo:
Legend of the degree of reliability

* low level : Detection of the car repairer, case study of the fault not found by the manufacturer.

** medium level : Extensive fault history, found by service technicians and repairers.

*** high level : Certainty of the fault, good degree of "repetition" reported by the manufacturer.

• System: Electronics

  • Device: Engine compartment fuse box

  • Fault: Occasionally, when the engine is cold, it starts normally but stalls immediately; at the same time, the engine fault warning light and the ABS warning light come on intermittently, and the vehicle runs roughly.

  • Fault codes detected by the on-board diagnostics:
  • C1221 (NCM engine control)
  • P0300 (Misfire in unspecified cylinders – Generic fault)
  • P0302 (Misfire in cylinder 2 – Generic fault)
  • P0303 (Misfire in cylinder 3 – Generic fault)
  • P0641 (Reference voltage sensor 1 – Malfunction/open circuit)
  • Cause: Contacts on the engine compartment fuse box compromised

• Task: Check the condition of the contacts on the engine compartment fuse box and replace it if necessary

  • Procedure: - -

  • Note: The component is located in the engine compartment, on the driver’s side near the battery.

    The estimated time required for the service is approximately 2.3 hours.
